observations: Photo 0 shows a wall-mounted solar power installation.
Two white wall-mounted inverters with circular central displays.
Three white floor-standing battery units with circular central displays.
An orange circular logo is visible on all units, consistent with Felicity Solar branding.
A watermark 'VC TECH ACCESSORIES' is visible across the center of the image.
The seller's text describes one battery and one inverter, but the photo shows three batteries and two inverters.
Technical specifications and model numbers on the units are not legible.

claims.evidence: The logo matches the brand, but a single photo of an installation does not prove authenticity or ownership.
The capacity labels on the floor-standing units are not legible in photo 0.
The capacity labels on the wall-mounted units are not legible in photo 0.

risks.risk: Quantity and Ownership: The photo shows a full installation (5 units) while the text offers single units, and the watermark suggests the photo belongs to a technical service provider.
risks.proof: A photo of the specific units for sale, uninstalled, with a handwritten note of the current date.
risks.if_unproven: as a potential scam or misrepresentation

risks.risk: Model and Capacity: Pricing for Felicity units depends entirely on the exact KVA and kWh ratings which are not visible.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the silver specification plates on the side of the inverter and the battery.
risks.if_unproven: at the lowest capacity for these physical dimensions

risks.risk: Battery Health: Lithium batteries lose value based on the number of charge cycles completed.
risks.proof: A photo of the battery's LCD screen showing the 'Cycle' count or 'SOH' (State of Health).
risks.if_unproven: as heavily used/near end of life

risks.risk: Functional Status: High-value power electronics may have internal faults not visible externally.
risks.proof: A video showing the units powered on, showing no error codes, and supporting a load.

proof_requests: Photo of the specification stickers on the side of the inverter and battery showing model and capacity.
Photo of the actual units for sale (not an installed system) with a handwritten note of today's date and your name.
Close-up photo of the battery screen showing the cycle count.
Video of the units powered on and functioning.
response.reason: The photo shows a different quantity of items than the text describes, and the watermark suggests the image may be a reference photo from a third party. Specific model numbers and capacities are not legible, preventing a worst-case price calculation.
